title.zh: Claude私聊触发人工审查，美国佛州女子写枪击威胁后被捕
title.en: Claude私聊触发人工审查，美国佛州女子写枪击威胁后被捕

current_state.zh: A Florida woman was arrested after writing a shooting threat in a private Claude chat that Anthropic's safety system flagged and its human review team forwarded to police, highlighting a growing pattern of AI chat content reaching law enforcement and unresolved legal questions about whether private AI conversations qualify as criminal threats.
